title: Release Readiness — Pre-Release Validation
description: Run tests, verify package metadata, verify documentation, inspect repository cleanliness, and generate a readiness report.

tasks.title: Verify package metadata
command: import tomllib; p=tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb')); proj=p['project']; checks={'name': bool(proj.get('name')), 'version': bool(proj.get('version')), 'description': bool(proj.get('description')), 'python': bool(proj.get('requires-python'))}; failed=[k for k,v in checks.items() if not v]; print(f'Metadata checks: {len(checks)-len(failed)}/{len(checks)} passed'); print('All metadata present' if not failed else f'Missing: {failed}')

tasks.title: Verify documentation exists
command: from pathlib import Path; docs=['README.md','docs/api.md']; existing=[d for d in docs if Path(d).exists()]; missing=[d for d in docs if not Path(d).exists()]; print(f'Documentation: {len(existing)}/{len(docs)} present'); print('All docs present' if not missing else f'Missing: {missing}')

tasks.title: Check repository cleanliness
command: import os; stale=[]; [stale.extend([os.path.join(r,f) for f in files if any(s in f for s in ['__pycache__','.pyc','.egg-info'])]) for r,_,files in os.walk('.') if '.git' not in r]; print(f'Stale files: {len(stale)}'); print('\n'.join(stale[:5]) if stale else 'Repository is clean')
